from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class BalanceSheetRecord(BaseModel):
    """Captures the key balance sheet line items required to calculate asset ratios for a single company."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="The stock or security code of the company")
    report_date: str | None = Field(description="The date of the report (YYYY-MM-DD or similar)")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="The currency of the financial figures")
    total_assets: float | None = Field(description="Total Assets value")
    monetary_funds: float | None = Field(description="Monetary Funds value")
    accounts_receivable: float | None = Field(description="Accounts Receivable value")
    fixed_assets: float | None = Field(description="Fixed Assets value")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_reports: list[BalanceSheetRecord]
